name: C4 Model DSL
description: Generate Structurizr C4 model using Structurizr DSL
helpContent: Create architecture diagrams using Structurizr's domain-specific language (DSL). Structurizr provides powerful C4 model support with views.
template:
Generate a Structurizr DSL definition showing:
1. Workspace definition
2. System landscape (systems and people)
3. System context (for chosen system)
4. Container view
5. Component views (if detailed enough)
6. Deployment views
7. Dynamic views (for flows)

Use proper Structurizr DSL syntax.

name: Views and Styling
description: Create styled Structurizr views with custom themes
helpContent: Design Structurizr diagrams with custom styling, colors, and themes for professional documentation.
template:
Create a Structurizr model with:
1. Multiple views (context, containers, components)
2. Custom styling and themes
3. Element descriptions and technology labels
4. Consistent visual language
5. Professional color schemes

Ensure views are clear and well-organized.
